check: R4 (secondary sanity line; Amendment 1 A1.7). Healthy real people: every red alert is a false alarm.
dataset: PMData (Thambawita et al., MMSys 2020; CC BY 4.0): Fitbit daily resting HR + self-reported weight
model: frozen hybrid model M (mismatched), frozen isotonic map and thresholds; nothing refitted

assumptions.baseline: no lab: creatinine back-calculated from baseline_egfr_fallback (§9.3 rule)
assumptions.hr_base: median of the first 28 resting-HR readings

caveats: Fitbit's daily resting HR is smoothed (day-to-day SD lower than our nightly value); weight is self-reported in whole kilograms; Norwegian winter, so heat never drives risk here.
